title: Side panel
description: A panel that slides in from the right over a dimmed page, to show a summary of the row that was pressed without leaving the list. Header with the title, a status pill and up to three grey lines; a button to open the full page and a close button; a scrolling body for your content; a footer of buttons. It covers the whole window, menu included, like a dialog, so it can be placed anywhere in a screen.

props.x: Pill beside the title. Variants: tint, solid, success, warning, error, info.
